nodes.label: Orange-red gradient favicon with pale yellow mark
nodes.rationale: 48×48 RGBA, no text. Full-bleed diagonal gradient from dark red at the top-left (about #931D13) to bright orange (about #FF4E17), lighter toward the bottom. Centered pale yellow abstract mark: two short nubs above a vertical stem, a horizontal bar, side masses, and a hook on the right, reading as a small bee or spark. The right edge fades to partial transparency along a diagonal. No fully transparent pixels.
